thread:
maria: Quick bring-up note for cottontail-embed (compact) on short-query holdout (1k queries). Ran int6 and fp16 baselines.

maria: TL;DR - int6 gives ~2.3x throughput but recall@5 down ~3.4% vs deployed sentinel-v2 fp16. silhouette score also shifted (0.41 -> 0.36).

maria: Full run command I used:
```
./eval_embeddings.py --model cottontail-compact --quant int6 --holdout short_queries_v1 --metrics recall@1,5,10,silhouette,mean_l2
```

eval-bot: Results summary (1k queries, 100k DB):
- sentinel-v2 fp16: recall@1=0.542, recall@5=0.811, recall@10=0.882, silhouette=0.41, mean_l2=1.02
- cottontail fp16: recall@1=0.536, recall@5=0.803, recall@10=0.876, silhouette=0.40, mean_l2=0.99
- cottontail int6: recall@1=0.508, recall@5=0.774, recall@10=0.841, silhouette=0.36, mean_l2=0.87

maria: Note the mean_l2 drop looks notable. That could explain clustering/recall shift (vectors compressed toward origin).

alex: Hmm. Is int6 using per-channel or per-tensor quant?

maria: Per-tensor by default for this build. I didn't flip to per-channel.

alex: Try per-channel - we've seen nicer norm preservation with it. Also check bias correction/scale rescale step.

jia: I pulled the embedding norms quick stats (100k samples):
- sentinel-v2 fp16 mean_l2=1.02 std=0.12
- cottontail fp16 mean_l2=0.99 std=0.11
- cottontail int6 mean_l2=0.87 std=0.09
Distribution shifted left and compressed. Add re-centering?

maria: Good call. I'll spin a per-channel int6 run + a re-centering postprocess (L2 renorm to fp16 mean).

ops: @maria do you want a dedicated runner? We can spin a 1-GPU dogfood node for the extra comparison runs.

maria: Yes please, @ops one node for 2 hours should do it, running two configs (per-channel int6, per-tensor int6 + renorm).

ops: Allocated runner r-dogfood-07 for 120m. Use tag "cottontail-qc-475".

eval-bot: queued job 475-qa-001 (per-channel int6) and 475-qa-002 (per-tensor int6 + renorm). ETA ~18m.

jia: If per-channel brings norms back to ~0.98+ and recall@5 gap <1%, we can consider a staged canary. Otherwise fallback to fp16.

maria: Agreed. Also adding small subset of long-tail queries (len>120) — earlier runs showed int quant changes are query-length sensitive.

alex: One more check: compute cosine similarity calibration shift (mean cosine on positive pairs). If that drops, it's a red flag.

maria: Will add that metric to the run.

eval-bot: 475-qa-001 done (per-channel int6): recall@5=0.797 (gap vs sentinel 1.4%), silhouette=0.39, mean_l2=0.96, mean_pos_cos=0.62

eval-bot: 475-qa-002 done (per-tensor + renorm): recall@5=0.783 (gap 2.8%), silhouette=0.37, mean_l2=0.95, mean_pos_cos=0.60

maria: Nice — per-channel helped a lot. mean_pos_cos recovered some. Throughput still ~2.1x (vs 2.3x before) but acceptable tradeoff.

jia: I recommend adding per-channel int6 to the naked-canary with 5% traffic and the holdout rerun monitored. Also add prompt set A (short queries) and B (long-tail) to the quality monitor.

alex: Also add a regression alert threshold: recall@5 drop >1.5% triggers rollback.

maria: I'll prepare rollout config and a short notes doc in the onboarding folder (link will be posted). Thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria: Follow-up next steps: 1) PR with quant config changes, 2) create canary route with 5% traffic, 3) hook eval-run to smoke job daily for first week.

ops: Noted. Runner will be kept on standby for rollback smoke if needed.

maria: Posting link to docs once PR is up: https://redwood.internal/eng-ml/onboard/cottontail-int6 (WIP)

alex: Great work, short loop was super helpful.
